book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Kushe Silida Addeza Paxateth
Hara gallas Yesusi Ayhuda Woosa Keeththe gelides. Heenkka kushey silidaadey dees.
Yesusa mootanaas gaaso koyza asati izi Ayhudata Sambata gallas paththanaakkon giidi paththishin beyana koyida.
Izikka kushey silida addeza, «Heen shiiqi uttida asaa sinththan denda eqqa» gides.
Hessafe guye Yesusi asaa, «Sambata gallas bessizay lo7o oosoyee? Iita oosoo? Asa shempo ashoyee? Woykko shempo wodhoo?» giidi oychchides. Isttika co7u gida.
Istta wozina shuchchateththan mishettidi iza giddoththidi yuuyi aadhdhi eqqida asaa hanqora xeellidi addeza, «Ne kusheza piddisa!» gides. Addezikka ba kushe piddisiin kushezi mulera paxides.
Farsaaweti kezi biidi iza wostti dhayssanaakko Herdoosa bagga gidida asatara zorettida.
Abbaa Lanqen Daro Asaa Shiiqo
Yesusi bana kaallizaytara abbaako bides. Galilappenne Yuhudappe yida daro derey iza kaallides.
Izi ooththizayssa siyidi asay Yuhudappe, Yerusalaameppe, Eedoomeppe, Yordaanoose pinththan diza deretappe qasse Xirooseppenne Sidoona heerappe izakko yides.
Asay darida gishshas iza un7eththontta mala guuththa wogolo istti giigsana mala bana kaallizayta azazides.
Izi daro harganchchata paththida gishshas sakoy waayisizayti wuri iza ba kushera bochchanaas dafettida.
Tuna ayanatikka Yesusa be7ida mala iza sinththan kundidi, «Neni Xoossa Naa» giidi waassida.
Gido attiin izi oonakko tuna ayanati qonccisontta mala keehippe hanqides.
Yesusa Kaalliza Tammanne Nam7ata Dooreteth
Yesusi pude zuma bolla kezidi ba koyzayta baakko yaana mala xeygides; isttika izakko yida.
Izara issife gidana malanne sabbakanaas yeddana mala tammanne nam7ata, «Hawaareta» gi sunththides.
Asaappe daydanththata kessana mala isttas godateth immides.
Izi sunththida tammanne nam7ata sunththi hayssafe kaallizayssa; Phexroosa geetettida Simoona,
Bi7orinegeese woykko daada nayta geetettida Zabdoosa nayta Yaaqoobenne Yohannisa,
Indiraasa, Piliphoosa, Bartelemoosa, Matoosa, Toomaasa, Ilfiyoosa naa Yaaqoobe, Tadoosa, ba baggas mishettiza Simoona,
Yesusa aaththi immida Asqoronto Yuhuda.
Yesusanne Bi7elizeebula
Hessafe guye Yesusi issi soo gelides. Izinne iza kaallizayti kath maana wodey isttas dhayana gakkanaas derey qasseka dari shiiqides.
Iza hanotaa siyida iza dabboti, «Gooyontta aggenna» giidi banara ekki baanaas izi dizaso gakkida.
Yerusalaameppe yida xaafetikka, «Bi7elizeebula geetettiza daydanththata halaqay iza bolla dees. Izi daydanththata kessizay daydanththata halaqa wolqqankko!» gida.
Izikka istta xeygidi leemisora, «Xala7ey asappe Xala7e wostti kessanee?
Ba giddon shaakoy diza kawoteththi minnanaas dandayenna.
Issi keeththa asikka ba giddon shaakettiko eqqanaas dandayenna.
Hessaththoka Xala7ey ba garsan issoy issaara shaakettikonne ixettiko minni eqqanaas dandayenna. Hessika izas wurseth gidana.
«Hessa gaason issaadey koyrottidi wolqqama as qachchontta dishe wolqqamaza soo gelanaassinne iza miishshe bonqqanaas dandayenna; iza aqo bonqqanaas dandayettizay wolqqamaza qachchiko xalala.
«Ta inttes tumu gays; asa naytas nagaraynne cashshi wuri maarettana.
Gido attiin Xillo Ayana bolla cashsha qaala haasayza asa ubbaas mernaas nagara aco gidana attiin maarettenna» gides.
Hessa izi giday istti iza, «Ne bolla tuna ayanay dees» gida gishshassa.
Yesusa Aayeyonne Iza Ishata
Hessafe guye iza aayeyanne iza ishati kare yi eqqidinne ase izakko kiitti xeygisida.
Iza giddoththi uttida daro asay, «Hekko ne aayeyanne ne ishati karen eqqidi nena koyeettes» gida.
Izikka zaaridi, «Ta aaya oonee? Ta ishati oonanttee?» gides.
Iza yuuyi uttida asaakko xeellidi, «Ta aayeyanne ta ishati haytanttako!
Xoossa shene ooththizay wuri izi ta isha, ta michchonne ta aayo» gides.
